rationale: Adds the official Ecovacs image family to live vacuum tracking and complete server path recording, including a new safe image-only manual alignment surface. This family was unsupported in v1.81.0; it is not a repair of an intermediate beta implementation.

summary.ru: Позиция и маршрут Ecovacs на готовом плане, с ручной подгонкой карты пола.
summary.en: Ecovacs position and native paths on an existing plan, with manual floor-map alignment.
